ei.title: Practice 02 — 전시회 부스 설치 작업 지연을 해결하기 위한 즉각적인 대책 요구
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, ①<u>recommended</u> your company as one that would do a good job of ②<u>building</u> our exhibition booths, but we have ③<u>saw</u> virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is ④<u>scheduled</u> for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① recommended=추천했다(과거 동사 정상), ② building=짓는 것(동명사 정상), ③ saw→seen 오류(현재완료에는 p.p. 필요), ④ scheduled=예정된(과거분사 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① recommended: 'recommended your company' — 과거 타동사 정상
❌ ② building: 'of building our exhibition booths' — 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 정상
✅ ③ saw: 'we have seen virtually no progress' — 현재완료 have+p.p. 구조에서 saw(과거형)는 오류. seen(과거분사)이 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ scheduled: 'is scheduled for March 3' — be+과거분사 수동태 정상
det.tip: 현재완료 = have/has + 과거분사(p.p.). see의 p.p.는 seen이므로 'have seen'이 맞음

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed ①<u>to have</u> the work ②<u>completing</u> one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question ③<u>whether</u> you will be able ④<u>to meet</u> the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① to have=~하게 하다(부정사 정상), ② completing→completed 오류(have+O+p.p. 구조에서 p.p. 필요), ③ whether=~인지(접속사 정상), ④ to meet=충족하다(부정사 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① to have: 'you agreed to have the work completed' — to부정사 정상
✅ ② completing: 'have the work completed' — have+목적어+목적보어 구조에서 목적어(the work)가 완료되는 수동관계이므로 과거분사(completed)가 맞음. completing으로 쓰면 오류 ← 정답
❌ ③ whether: 'I question whether' — 간접의문문 접속사 정상
❌ ④ to meet: 'be able to meet' — be able to+동사원형 정상
det.tip: have+O+p.p.: 목적어가 행위를 당하는 수동 관계일 때 p.p. 사용. 'have the work completed' = 일이 완료되게 하다

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very ①<u>concerned</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about ②<u>how</u> you intend ③<u>to complete</u> the work on time. If it ④<u>appear</u> that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① concerned=걱정되는(형용사 정상), ② how=어떻게(간접의문문 정상), ③ to complete=완료하다(부정사 정상), ④ appear→appears 오류(3인칭 단수 주어 it에 동사 수 일치 필요)
det.analysis:
❌ ① concerned: 'I am very concerned about' — be+형용사 구조 정상
❌ ② how: 'about how you intend' — 전치사 about 뒤 간접의문사절 정상
❌ ③ to complete: 'how you intend to complete' — intend to+동사원형 정상
✅ ④ appear: 'If it appears that' — 주어 it(3인칭 단수)에 맞춰 appears가 맞음. appear(원형)로 쓰면 수 일치 오류 ← 정답
det.tip: it appears that ~ = ~인 것처럼 보이다. 주어 it은 단수이므로 appears(3인칭 단수)

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen ①<u>virtually</u> no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week ②<u>prior</u> to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very ③<u>relieved</u> about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take ④<u>immediate</u> measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① virtually=사실상(거의 진전이 없다는 문맥에 적절), ② prior=이전의(개막 1주 전 문맥에 적절), ③ relieved→concerned 오류(계약 이행을 걱정하는 맥락에서 '안도된'은 부적절), ④ immediate=즉각적인(자구 조치 문맥에 적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① virtually: 'virtually no progress' — 거의 진전이 없다는 부정 강조 정상
❌ ② prior: 'one week prior to the opening' — 개막 1주 전 완료 합의 문맥 정상
✅ ③ relieved: 'I am very relieved about being ready for the conference' — 발신인은 계약 이행 여부를 걱정하므로 concerned(걱정되는)가 맞음. relieved(안도된)는 문맥 반대 ← 정답
❌ ④ immediate: 'take immediate measure' — 즉각 조치 문맥 정상
det.tip: concerned = 걱정되는 / relieved = 안도되는. 부스 설치 지연 상황에서 작성자는 불안을 표현해야 함

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, ①<u>criticized</u> your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our ②<u>advance</u> payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will ③<u>default</u> on this contract, we will take immediate measure to ④<u>protect</u> ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① criticized→recommended 오류(형제가 회사를 비판한 게 아니라 추천했다는 문맥), ② advance=선(先), 사전의(선불 지급 문맥에 적절), ③ default=불이행하다(계약 위반 위협 문맥에 적절), ④ protect=보호하다(자구 조치 문맥에 적절)
det.analysis:
✅ ① criticized: 'recommended your company' — 형제가 부스 제작 회사를 '추천'했다는 내용. criticized(비판했다)로 바꾸면 문맥에 맞지 않음 ← 정답
❌ ② advance: 'our advance payment' — 사전 납부(선불)를 했다는 문맥 정상
❌ ③ default: 'you will default on this contract' — 계약 불이행 위협 문맥 정상
❌ ④ protect: 'to protect ourselves' — 법적 자구 조치 문맥 정상
det.tip: recommend = 추천하다 / criticize = 비판하다. 글의 도입부는 형제의 '추천'으로 거래 시작했음을 밝힘

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will __________ on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① question=의심하다, ② protect=보호하다, ③ complete=완료하다, ④ default=채무불이행하다 ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ④ default: 'If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure' — 계약을 이행하지 않을 경우 조치를 취하겠다는 경고. default on a contract = 계약 불이행 ← 정답
❌ ① question: 의심하다 — 주어 it과 어울리지 않고 문맥상 부적절
❌ ② protect: 보호하다 — 뒤 문장에서 목적으로 등장하는 단어로 문맥 부적절
❌ ③ complete: 완료하다 — 계약을 완료한다는 의미로 쓰이지 않음
det.tip: default on a contract = 계약 불이행. 이후 'take immediate measure to protect ourselves'가 결과

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our __________, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① contract copy=계약서 사본, ② advance payment=선불(사전 납부) ← 정답, ③ recent weeks=최근 몇 주, ④ opening date=개막일
det.analysis:
✅ ② advance payment: 'With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening' — 선불을 이미 했기 때문에 계약 이행 요구가 정당화됨 ← 정답
❌ ① contract copy: 계약서 사본은 동봉된 증거물이지 납부 수단이 아님
❌ ③ recent weeks: 최근 몇 주는 진전이 없었던 기간을 나타내며 납부와 무관
❌ ④ opening date: 개막일은 날짜 정보이지 납부 방식이 아님
det.tip: advance payment = 선불. '이미 선불을 했으니 계약대로 이행하라'는 논리 구조

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 부스 제작은 최근 거의 진전이 없음(불일치), ② Daniel Jones 형제가 추천(일치) ← 정답, ③ 선불 납부 후 계약(불일치), ④ 컨퍼런스는 3월 3일(불일치)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'we have seen virtually no progress' — 진전이 없다고 함
✅ ② 'My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company' — 형제가 추천 ← 정답
❌ ③ 'With our advance payment, you agreed' — 선불 납부 후 계약
❌ ④ 'Our conference is scheduled for March 3' — 3월 3일
det.tip: 첫 문장에서 형제의 추천으로 계약했다는 사실이 명시됨

ch: 전시회 부스 제작은 계획대로 순조롭게 진행되고 있다.
작성자의 형제가 이 회사를 추천해 주었다.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 계약서 사본 동봉(일치), ② 서면 후속 연락 요청(일치), ③ 개막 1주 전 완료(불일치 — '이틀'이 아님) ← 정답, ④ 즉각 조치 언급(일치)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'contract copy enclosed' — 계약서 사본 동봉 일치
❌ ② 'follow up in writing' — 서면 연락 요청 일치
✅ ③ 'completed one week prior to the opening' — 1주 전이지 이틀 전이 아님 ← 정답
❌ ④ 'we will take immediate measure' — 즉각 조치 일치
det.tip: one week prior to = 1주 전. '이틀 전'으로 바꾸면 숫자 변조 오답

ch: 작성자는 회사에 서면으로 후속 연락을 요청했다.
회사는 개막일 이틀 전까지 작업을 완료하기로 했다.
계약 불이행 시 즉각 자구 조치를 취하겠다고 밝혔다.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 계약 이행 의심(일치), ② 즉각 자구 조치(일치), ③ 전화+서면(일치), ④ 계약 이전 확인 — 지문에 없음(불일치) ← 정답
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'I question whether you will be able to meet the terms' — 계약 이행 의심 일치
❌ ② 'take immediate measure to protect ourselves' — 즉각 자구 조치 일치
❌ ③ 'Please call me, and follow up in writing' — 전화+서면 일치
✅ ④ 계약 이전에 작업 상황을 확인했다는 내용은 지문에 없음 ← 정답
det.tip: 지문에 없는 정보를 사실처럼 서술한 오답 유형

ch: 작성자는 회사가 계약 조건을 충족할 수 있을지 의심하고 있다.
작성자는 계약 불이행 시 즉각적인 자구 조치를 취하겠다고 밝혔다.
작성자는 작업 완료 방법에 대해 전화와 서면 연락 모두를 요청했다.
작성자는 계약 이전에 이미 회사의 작업 진행 상황을 확인한 바 있다.

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 부스 제작 지연 불만+이행 촉구 ← 정답, ② 업체 선정 기준 — 지문 미언급, ③ 참가자 안내 — 내부 서신 아님, ④ 법적 절차 — 부수적 언급에 불과
det.analysis:
✅ ① 이 서신의 핵심은 부스 제작 진전이 없음을 지적하고 계약 이행을 요구하는 것 ← 정답
❌ ② 업체 선정 기준은 지문에서 다루지 않음
❌ ③ 컨퍼런스 참가자 안내문이 아님
❌ ④ 법적 조치는 조건절로 언급된 수단이지 주제 아님
det.tip: 클레임 레터(claim letter)의 핵심 = 문제 지적 + 이행 요구

ch: 전시회 부스 제작 계약 지연에 대한 불만과 이행 촉구
행사 준비를 위해 전문 업체를 선정하는 기준
컨퍼런스 일정 변경과 관련한 참가자 안내
계약 분쟁 발생 시 법적 해결 절차 안내

questions.passage: My brother, Daniel Jones, recommended your company as one that would do a good job of building our exhibition booths, but we have seen virtually no progress on the project during recent weeks. Our conference is scheduled for March 3. With our advance payment, you agreed to have the work completed one week prior to the opening (contract copy enclosed). I question whether you will be able to meet the terms of the contract, and I am very concerned about being ready for the conference. Please call me, and follow up in writing, about how you intend to complete the work on time. If it appears that you will default on this contract, we will take immediate measure to protect ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 설계 개선 제안 — 지문 미언급, ② 계약 불이행 경고+해결 요구 ← 정답, ③ 사과 — 발신자 입장의 클레임, ④ 소송 개시 — 조건부 위협 수준
det.analysis:
❌ ① 설계 개선은 언급 없음
